data.one_liner: Dynamic grid dashboard widget allowing users to create, resize, and move layouts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a dynamic dashboard widget where users can create their own layouts with support for resizing, moving, and auto re-layout. It supports a storage delegate to persist layouts to a database or local disk, and handles both mobile and desktop input.
use_when: You need a customizable grid dashboard where users can add, remove, move, or resize widgets.
You need to persist user-configured dashboard layouts using local storage or a database.
avoid_when: You only need a simple fixed grid layout without user interactivity or drag-and-drop editing.
strengths: Supports drag-and-drop moving and resizing across mobile and desktop platforms.
Includes a storage delegate interface for easy persistence of layout configurations.
Features auto re-layout and slot adjustment on window size changes.
weaknesses: Tests are pending and marked as a TODO in the README.
Animation bugs and performance improvements are still under ongoing development.

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you need advanced, complex staggered grid layouts without the full dynamic dashboard editing feature set.
